page.overview:
What is Speed Racer?

Speed Racer was a licensed theme released in 2008 and discontinued the same year. Based on the film of the same name, which in turn was based on the 1967 anime of the same name by Tatsunoko Productions, it was a small line featuring only four sets, since the film was a box-office flop. The vehicles are drawn mainly from the pure speed-racing segments of the film, with only Cruncher Block's truck featuring any of the hidden weapon upgrades the cars are seen using at some points on-screen.
